about: Everything FWGC++ fetches from outside the repository, in one list: what it is, where it comes from, exactly which bytes (size and hash), under what licence, who uses it, whether it ships, and when the owner approved it.
A build fetches only through dependencies.cmake (fwgc_dependency), from a shared cache checked by hash; `cmake -P dependencies.cmake` fetches for a new machine. Nothing is committed.

A new dependency is added here, with the owner's approval of the file, its source and its size, in the same commit that first uses it. tools/check_layers holds every entry to the fields below and refuses a build that fetches any other way.

fetch: 'build' (a CMake configure fetches it), 'tool' (cmake -P dependencies.cmake fetches it on request), 'pip' (pip installs it from a hash-locked requirements file), 'manual' (a person installs it). ships: 'yes', 'no' or 'planned'.

dependencies.name: llama_cpp
dependencies.what: llama.cpp, the engine of the model runtime: built into inference; its converter, gguf-py and quantizer serve training
dependencies.obligations: Its copyright and licence notice goes with the game.

dependencies.name: sqlite
dependencies.what: SQLite, the amalgamation: the brain database inside the director

dependencies.name: qwen2_5_0_5b_instruct_q4_0
dependencies.what: The test model: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, quantized Q4_0; the tests that need a model run it
dependencies.obligations: Its licence and notice go with anything that ships it; it is not shipped.

dependencies.name: qwen3_4b_instruct_2507_q4_k_m
dependencies.what: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, quantized Q4_K_M: reads the player (and the base the voice is tuned from)
dependencies.obligations: Its licence and notice go with the game if it ships.

dependencies.name: qwen3_embedding_0_6b_q8_0
dependencies.what: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, quantized Q8_0: compares the player's words with written subjects
dependencies.obligations: Its licence and notice go with the game if it ships.

dependencies.name: qwen3_4b_instruct_2507_weights
dependencies.what: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507's own weights and tokenizer, at one revision: the base the voice's LoRA is trained on and merged into
dependencies.obligations: Its licence and notice go with any model made from it that ships.

dependencies.name: python_training
dependencies.what: The training pipeline's Python packages, torch among them: every wheel pinned by version and hash in the lock file
dependencies.licence: Each package's own: BSD, MIT and Apache-2.0 (torch BSD-3-Clause)
dependencies.obligations: None: dev-time only, and nothing of it ships.

dependencies.name: vulkan_sdk
dependencies.what: The LunarG Vulkan SDK: the shader compiler the GPU build of inference needs to build its Vulkan backend
dependencies.obligations: None: nothing of the SDK ships. The game uses the player's driver's Vulkan loader.
dependencies.approved: 2026-09-24, the owner, who ran the installer (its SHA-256 matched LunarG's published hash then)
